label: Circle to point
description: A screenshot card above the face; then, on the word that names it, a red hand-drawn loop around one spot on it. params.circle is the spot as [x, y, w, h] fractions of the picture.

circle.help: [x, y, w, h], fractions of the picture

circleAt.help: word id the loop lands on; default = the anchor's second word
